increment: The Product Goal now reaches the fixed public Context, native Controller/Seat admission, Task/Package/Lineage/Recipe, Decision, one native-controlled Action, validated Pi Result, Objective Outcome, Evaluation and candidate-only Dream proposal. Action completion replay does not synthesize a second Result.

The product request has an explicit test-draft path. Tauri supplies its cloud compilation Git SHA and hashes the service entry it launches; the Node service rehashes its loaded entry, checks current native admission and the existing Owner gh login, then uses the pinned no-force Git writer and immutable readback. Cloud integration exercised this same product Action path with a controlled Git port; it did not claim a real Owner-machine gh subprocess run.

A separate Controller-owned CAS write placed exact public cloud Product Result bytes on the Owner-authorized test ledger branch and independently read back commit, blob and SHA-256. The branch fact remains a draft, never adoption or Goal Acceptance.
